raw_text: Protests continued in South Kashmir's Shopian and Pulwama districts on Monday following a controversial encounter. Despite an internet shutdown, protest coordination persisted through VPN-tunneled social media posts. Stone pelting incidents at three locations led to security force deployment with tear gas. The Kashmir Observer reports that coded language was used extensively in rally coordination messages.
clean_text: Protests in Shopian and Pulwama continued despite internet shutdown via VPN-tunneled posts. Stone pelting at three locations. Coded language used in rally coordination messages.
